entities.name: Staff of Nin
entities.description: A staff attuned to the screams of others so that only its wielder may benefit from their pain.

entities.name: Volux
entities.description: A disciple of Nin who attuned the staff to his victims' screams.

entities.name: Nin
entities.description: A figure whose disciple is Volux and whose name the Staff of Nin bears.

entities.name: Gaddock Teeg
entities.description: A speaker who remarks on the dangers of living on a giant's back.

relations.note: Volux is a disciple of Nin.
